gates.name: Production domain and hosting
gates.required: Owner-selected domain mftintelligence.com; verify apex/www DNS and origin ownership, custom domain route safety, live headers and hosting account authorization before deployment

gates.name: Privacy, Terms and legal
gates.required: Verify that the final Privacy Policy and Terms match actual hosting and email data flows; satisfy mandatory controller name/address disclosure, applicable POTRAZ licensing/DPO/notifications, international transfer and security duties, retention schedules, data-subject rights and any applicable Consumer Protection Act electronic-transaction particulars. Do not claim compliance without evidence. Source-level 2026-11-06 policy draft has 13 privacy and 12 terms sections, but operator particulars, retention schedule, vendor arrangements and statutory compliance evidence are not yet verified.

gates.name: Contact and support
gates.required: confirmed corporate delivery, verified support route and escalation tests

gates.name: Final brand and media rights
gates.required: Owner approval of Axis Knot mark, 82-second Studio recording and scrubbed poster is recorded. Verify exact hashes in the authorized build, accessible video text alternative, third-party marks/rights, raw-media distribution scope, and historical public Git object exposure.

gates.name: Independent security, accessibility, hosted performance
gates.required: Independent WCAG/security acceptance, Chrome/Firefox/WebKit/Safari on exact PR #32 artifact, hosted Web Vitals, prior mobile CLS resolution, manual axe/AT review; previous protected preview tests do not transfer

gates.name: Existing Intelligence preservation
gates.required: owner-approved diff/real live app regression/origin/workspace preservation

gates.name: Production monitoring, backup and rollback
gates.required: service/account owner, alerts, backups, tested restore/rollback rehearsal
